name: Sapphira
title: The Woman Who Lied to the Holy Spirit
summary: Sapphira was married to Ananias and was a member of the early Christian church in Jerusalem. Together with her husband, she sold a property but withheld part of the proceeds while pretending to give everything to the apostles. Their deception toward the Holy Spirit resulted in immediate death and served as a serious warning for the early church.

keyEvents.title: Sale of Property
keyEvents.description: Sapphira and her husband Ananias sold a property but agreed to keep back part of the proceeds for themselves while pretending to give the full amount to the apostles.

keyEvents.title: Ananias' Deception and Death
keyEvents.description: Ananias brought part of the money to the apostles, pretending it was the full amount. Peter exposed the deception, stating that Ananias had lied to the Holy Spirit, after which Ananias fell down dead.

keyEvents.title: Sapphira Arrives Unaware of Her Husband's Death
keyEvents.description: About three hours later, Sapphira came in without knowing what had happened to her husband Ananias.

keyEvents.title: Peter Confronts Sapphira
keyEvents.description: Peter asked Sapphira if the property had been sold for the stated amount. She confirmed the lie and upheld the deception she and her husband had agreed upon.

keyEvents.title: The Death of Sapphira
keyEvents.description: Peter rebuked Sapphira for having conspired with her husband to test the Spirit of the Lord. Immediately she fell dead at his feet, and the young men carried her out and buried her beside her husband.

keyEvents.title: Great Fear in the Church
keyEvents.description: The incident involving Ananias and Sapphira caused great fear throughout the entire church and among all who heard about it, highlighting the seriousness of lying to God.
